main: Her first use consumes less resources, gives her some {st:Breath} and {st:Charge}, and gives her {st:BulletHole} and {st:BlackWingHole}. {st:BulletHole} is used for every succeeding use of the E.G.O, while {st:BlackWingHole} is a persistent buff for the rest of the fight giving her {st:Charge} Count and {st:AttackUp} every turn and some additional damage for {st:Charge} and {st:Breath} skills that scales up over time.

She gets 5 {st:BulletHole} on her first use of the E.G.O. All stacks are consumed on all subsequent uses to buff it, then she resets at 1 stack and gains 1 every turn. At 5 stacks, using the E.G.O does not consume resources.
other: Her passive heals SP and gives {st:Enhancement} to allies who kill enemies. It also gives her +5 {st:Charge} Count cap and {st:Breath} whenever she overcaps on {st:Charge}.

passiveList.desc:
If this unit has 5 [BulletHole], does not consume E.G.O Resource when using "Hollow" E.G.O's Skills (both Awakening and Corrosion)

Turn Start: Gain 1 [BulletHole] and 1 [BlackWingHole]

When an ally defeats an enemy, the said ally heals 5 SP and gains 1 [Enhancement] next turn (once per turn)

[Charge] Count max cap +5

If this unit gains [Charge] Count past the max [Charge] Count Cap, this unit randomly gains [Breath] Potency or Count equal to the surplus [Charge] Count gained (max 6 [Charge] Count converted per turn)
passiveList.flavor:
It is not penetration that bores a hollow; it is emptiness.
The hollow desires to be filled, yet instead, things only ever spill forth from within.
passiveList.name: Le Trou de Vidange
